audit_items.proof_trace: For any t2 > t1, hours2 = floor(secs2/3600) >= hours1 = floor(secs1/3600), so reduction2 = hourly_drop * hours2 >= reduction1; saturating_sub(base, reduction2) <= saturating_sub(base, reduction1) follows directly. The DeleverageParams are stored in an immutable TimeLock with no update path, so base and hourly_drop cannot change mid-session, and the Clock object is a consensus-enforced monotone source.
